_about: Round 9 (2026-11-25): still smoother music (Anthony after round 8: 'Better, but not smooth enough still'). Earlier rounds are in variants_round*.json.

variants.label: Sections, all played by the same instruments
variants.why: Until now each section had its own instruments, so every change sounded like a different band walking in. Here the instruments stay the same and only the energy changes.

variants.label: One continuous piece, same instruments throughout
variants.why: The one-piece version from last round, but each rewritten section keeps the same instruments.

variants.label: One continuous piece, joins left untouched
variants.why: As above, and the second on each side of every change is left exactly as first composed, so the music plays straight through the change.

variants.label: One continuous piece, joins untouched, volume glides slowly
variants.why: As above, and the volume takes three seconds to move between sections instead of under one.
